metadata.name: lite_psm
metadata.description: LitePSM - USDC to OkuMoney peg stability module

instructions.name: accept_role_admin
docs: Complete a `RoleAdmin` rotation; signed by the proposed admin.

accounts.name: new_role_admin
docs: Must match `config.pending_role_admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: `role_admin`, `pending_role_admin`).

instructions.name: burn_oku_m_direct
docs: Burn the caller's OkuM without a USDC payout (`direct_burner` only; the
source leg of a bridge out of this chain). Consumes the direct-burner allowance.

accounts.name: direct_burner
docs: The configured `direct_burner`; owns and signs for the burned account.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA. Writable because the direct-burn allowance is
drawn down; `has_one` enforces the role.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is defense in depth.

accounts.name: burner_oku_m_ata
docs: The burner's own account; source of the burn.

instructions.name: cancel_role_admin_transfer
docs: Withdraw a pending `RoleAdmin` proposal (`role_admin` only).

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: The current `role_admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: role keys / `pending_role_admin`).

instructions.name: deposit_buffer
docs: Add USDC to the redemption buffer (`buffer_depositor` only). Blocked while
paused and in the slot of a multiplier override.

accounts.name: buffer_depositor
docs: The configured `buffer_depositor` (enforced by `has_one` on `config`).

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA; read-only here.

accounts.name: buffer_depositor_usdc_ata
docs: Buffer depositor's USDC account

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint, for `transfer_checked`.

instructions.name: freeze_account
docs: Freeze an OkuM token account (`freezer` only). Works while paused.

accounts.name: freezer
docs: Works while paused.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA; read-only here. Signs the freeze as freeze authority.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022)

accounts.name: target_oku_m_ata
docs: Token account to freeze

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup, callable only by the program's upgrade authority. Creates
the config PDA, the USDC vault and the OkuM Token-2022 mint.

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: Becomes `config.role_admin`. Must be the program's upgrade authority
(see `program_data`). Otherwise `initialize` is a land-grab: `config` is a
singleton PDA, deploy and initialize are separate transactions, and
whoever lands first becomes `role_admin` permanently and picks `usdc_mint`
(only its decimals are validated). There is no re-init, so the program ID
would be unrecoverable.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData, proving `role_admin` is the upgrade authority.
Checked at runtime rather than a hardcoded key, so one binary serves every
cluster; passing it grants nothing the upgrade authority lacks.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA, created here (seed `psm_config`).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint (standard SPL); must have `USDC_DECIMALS` decimals.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: Fresh keypair for the OkuM mint, created in the handler (`CreateAccount`
needs the new account to sign).

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault (ATA of `config`).

instructions.name: mint_oku_m
docs: Mint OkuM for USDC at the canonical multiplier:
`raw_oku_m = usdc_amount * PRECISION / multiplier`, rounded down.

accounts.name: user
docs: Pays the USDC, receives the OkuM, and pays rent if their OkuM account is
created here. Permissionless.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA. Writable because the PSM mint allowance is drawn
down on every mint.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint. Unchecked to skip deserialization: it is only forwarded to
`transfer_checked`, which validates mint and decimals itself.
forwarded as an `AccountInfo` to `transfer_checked`, which validates it.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is defense in depth.

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: User's USDC account; any account the user owns (it is never created here).

accounts.name: user_oku_m_ata
docs: User's OkuM account. `associated_token::` because `init_if_needed` needs
the canonical address.

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault. Unchecked for the same reason as `usdc_mint`.
forwarded as an `AccountInfo` to `transfer_checked`, which validates it.

instructions.name: mint_oku_m_direct
docs: Mint OkuM without USDC (`direct_minter` only; fiat on-ramp and the SVM->SVM
bridge destination leg). Consumes the direct-minter allowance and respects
the supply cap.

accounts.name: direct_minter
docs: Also pays for recipient ATA creation.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA. Writable because the direct-mint allowance is
drawn down; `has_one` makes the signer the configured `direct_minter`.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is defense in depth.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: Recipient of the minted OkuM; does not sign.

accounts.name: recipient_oku_m_ata
docs: Recipient's OkuM token account, created if missing.

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause mint, redeem, direct mint/burn and buffer moves (`pauser` only).
Freeze/thaw and rate decreases stay available.

accounts.name: pauser
docs: The configured `pauser`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the pause flag).

instructions.name: redeem_oku_m
docs: Redeem OkuM for USDC from the buffer:
`usdc_amount = raw_oku_m_amount * multiplier / PRECISION`, rounded down.
Reverts with `SlippageExceeded` below `min_usdc_out` (`0` disables).

accounts.name: user
docs: Burns the OkuM, receives the USDC, and pays rent if their USDC account is
created here. Permissionless.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA. Read-only: a redeem changes no config state (it
only signs the vault transfer).

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint (pinned to the configured one)

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022). `mint::authority = config` is defense in depth.

accounts.name: user_usdc_ata
docs: User's USDC account, receives the payout. Created if missing so a user
who has never held USDC can still redeem.

accounts.name: user_oku_m_ata
docs: User's OkuM account; source of the burn

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault; source of the payout. Typed (deserialized) because the
handler reads its balance for the `InsufficientBuffer` check.

instructions.name: set_authority
docs: Replace the authority for `role` (`role_admin` only). For `RoleAdmin` this
only proposes the new admin; it takes effect on `accept_role_admin`.

accounts.name: role_admin
docs: The current `role_admin`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: role keys / `pending_role_admin`).

instructions.name: set_direct_burner_allowance
docs: Reset the `burn_oku_m_direct` allowance in raw OkuM units
(`allowance_manager` only).

accounts.name: allowance_manager
docs: The configured `allowance_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the allowances).

instructions.name: set_direct_minter_allowance
docs: Reset the `mint_oku_m_direct` allowance in raw OkuM units
(`allowance_manager` only).

accounts.name: allowance_manager
docs: The configured `allowance_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the allowances).

instructions.name: set_max_supply
docs: Set the supply cap in raw OkuM units (`cap_manager` only). Cannot be set
below current supply.

accounts.name: cap_manager
docs: The configured `cap_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: `max_supply`).

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint, read so `set_max_supply` can refuse a cap below current supply.

instructions.name: set_minter_allowance
docs: Reset the `mint_oku_m` allowance in raw OkuM units (`allowance_manager` only).

accounts.name: allowance_manager
docs: The configured `allowance_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the allowances).

instructions.name: set_next_okum_yield_rate
docs: Stage the successor rate that takes over at the current `okum_rate_end`
with no transaction at the boundary (`rate_manager` only).

accounts.name: rate_manager
docs: The configured `rate_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the rate schedule).

instructions.name: set_okum_multiplier
docs: EMERGENCY (`rate_manager` only): force the multiplier (WAD-scaled) to a strictly
higher value and halt accrual. The only instruction that engages the
same-slot yield lock.

accounts.name: rate_manager
docs: The configured `rate_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the schedule is collapsed).

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint; its `ScaledUiAmount` display multiplier is rewritten.

instructions.name: set_okum_yield_rate
docs: Set the active per-second rate and its window (`rate_manager` only). Re-anchors
the base multiplier and clears any staged successor. `end_timestamp` must
be `0` for a halt (`PRECISION`) and in the future otherwise.

accounts.name: rate_manager
docs: The configured `rate_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the rate schedule).

instructions.name: set_okum_yield_rate_with_successor
docs: Set the active rate and stage its successor atomically (`rate_manager` only);
the epoch orchestrator's instruction.

accounts.name: rate_manager
docs: The configured `rate_manager`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the rate schedule).

instructions.name: sync_display_multiplier
docs: Refresh the wallet-facing `ScaledUiAmount` mirror to the current canonical
multiplier. Permissionless: the value is fully determined on-chain.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: `last_display_sync_ts`). Signs the
mirror update as `ScaledUiAmount` authority.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint; its `ScaledUiAmount` display multiplier is rewritten.

instructions.name: thaw_account
docs: Thaw an OkuM token account (`unfreezer` only). Works while paused.

accounts.name: unfreezer
docs: Works while paused.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA; read-only here. Signs the thaw as freeze authority.

accounts.name: oku_m_mint
docs: OkuM mint (Token-2022)

accounts.name: target_oku_m_ata
docs: Target account to thaw

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Resume operation (`unpauser` only).

accounts.name: unpauser
docs: The configured `unpauser`.

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA (writable: the pause flag).

instructions.name: withdraw_buffer
docs: Remove USDC from the buffer (`buffer_withdrawer` only). Blocked while
paused and in the slot of a multiplier override.

accounts.name: buffer_withdrawer
docs: The configured `buffer_withdrawer` (enforced by `has_one` on `config`).

accounts.name: config
docs: The singleton config PDA; read-only here. It owns the vault and signs the transfer out.

accounts.name: withdrawer_usdc_ata
docs: Buffer withdrawer's USDC account (destination)

accounts.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC vault (source)

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint, for `transfer_checked`.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller not authorized

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: Program is paused

errors.name: AlreadyPaused
errors.msg: Program is already paused

errors.name: NotPaused
errors.msg: Program is not paused

errors.name: MaxSupplyExceeded
errors.msg: Mint would exceed max supply

errors.name: BelowCurrentSupply
errors.msg: New max_supply must be >= current circulating supply

errors.name: AllowanceExceeded
errors.msg: Mint would exceed minter allowance

errors.name: InsufficientBuffer
errors.msg: Insufficient buffer for redemption

errors.name: InsufficientUserBalance
errors.msg: User does not hold enough OkuM for redemption

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: Amount must be greater than zero

errors.name: OverrideInProgress
errors.msg: Cannot perform operation in the same slot as a multiplier override

errors.name: MultiplierCannotDecrease
errors.msg: New multiplier must strictly increase

errors.name: InvalidRate
errors.msg: Rate must be >= PRECISION (the multiplier cannot decrease)

errors.name: RateTooHigh
errors.msg: Rate exceeds MAX_RATE

errors.name: EndTimestampNotAllowed
errors.msg: A halted rate must not carry an end timestamp

errors.name: EndTimestampInPast
errors.msg: A yielding rate requires an end timestamp in the future

errors.name: RateWindowTooLong
errors.msg: Rate window exceeds the maximum permitted length (90 days)

errors.name: NoRateEndSet
errors.msg: Cannot stage a successor: no active rate window is set

errors.name: RateAlreadyExpired
errors.msg: Cannot stage a successor: the active rate window has already expired

errors.name: PendingEndNotAfterRateEnd
errors.msg: Successor expiry must be strictly after the active rate end

errors.name: MultiplierTooHigh
errors.msg: Proposed multiplier exceeds MAX_MULTIPLIER ceiling

errors.name: MultiplierOutOfRange
errors.msg: Multiplier could not be computed from the current rate schedule

errors.name: MultiplierUpdateFailed
errors.msg: Failed to update ScaledUiAmount multiplier

errors.name: InvalidAuthority
errors.msg: Authority pubkey is invalid (e.g. zero pubkey)

errors.name: NoPendingRoleAdmin
errors.msg: No pending role-admin transfer to accept

errors.name: NotPendingRoleAdmin
errors.msg: Caller is not the pending role admin

errors.name: InvalidUsdcDecimals
errors.msg: USDC mint must have exactly 6 decimals

errors.name: AmountTooSmall
errors.msg: Output amount too small (rounds to zero)

errors.name: SlippageExceeded
errors.msg: Redeem output is below min_usdc_out

types.name: AuthorityRole
docs: Roles settable via `set_authority`.

types.name: AuthorityUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted when a role is updated. A `RoleAdmin` rotation fires it only on
acceptance; the proposal emits `RoleAdminTransferProposedEvent`.

types.name: BufferDepositEvent
docs: Emitted on a buffer deposit. EVM: `BufferDeposited`.

fields.name: depositor
docs: The `buffer_depositor` that sent the USDC

fields.name: amount
docs: USDC deposited (6 decimals)

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: Vault USDC balance after the deposit (6 decimals)

types.name: BufferWithdrawEvent
docs: Emitted on a buffer withdrawal. EVM: `BufferWithdrawn`.

fields.name: actor
docs: The `buffer_withdrawer` that received the USDC

fields.name: amount
docs: USDC withdrawn (6 decimals)

fields.name: new_buffer_balance
docs: Vault USDC balance after the withdrawal (6 decimals)

types.name: DirectBurnEvent
docs: Emitted by `burn_oku_m_direct` (no USDC payout). EVM: ERC-20 `Transfer` to the zero address.

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM burned (6 decimals)

types.name: DirectBurnerAllowanceUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted by `set_direct_burner_allowance`. No EVM counterpart.

types.name: DirectMintEvent
docs: Emitted by `mint_oku_m_direct` (no USDC). EVM: ERC-20 `Transfer` from the zero address.

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM minted (6 decimals)

types.name: DirectMinterAllowanceUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted by `set_direct_minter_allowance`. EVM: `MinterAllowanceUpdated`.

types.name: DisplayMultiplierSynced
docs: Emitted when the wallet display mirror is refreshed (informational only).

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical multiplier written, effective immediately

types.name: FreezeEvent
docs: Emitted by `freeze_account`. EVM: `Blacklisted`.

types.name: InitializeEvent
docs: Emitted by `initialize`. EVM: OZ `Initialized(uint64)`.

types.name: InitializeParams
docs: Parameter bundle for [`initialize`]. Named fields keep the call site hard to
scramble. Pubkey fields are the granular authorities (`roles::AuthorityRole`).

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Supply cap in raw OkuM units (6 decimals).

fields.name: minter_allowance
docs: Initial `mint_oku_m` allowance in raw OkuM units (6 decimals).

fields.name: pauser
docs: Can pause the PSM.

fields.name: unpauser
docs: Can unpause the PSM.

fields.name: freezer
docs: Can freeze OkuM token accounts.

fields.name: unfreezer
docs: Can thaw OkuM token accounts.

fields.name: buffer_depositor
docs: Can add USDC to the redemption vault.

fields.name: buffer_withdrawer
docs: Can take USDC out of the redemption vault.

fields.name: cap_manager
docs: Can change the supply cap.

fields.name: allowance_manager
docs: Can reset the mint / direct-mint / direct-burn allowances.

fields.name: rate_manager
docs: Sets the yield-rate schedule and the emergency multiplier override.

fields.name: oku_m_uri
docs: Token-2022 metadata URI for the OkuM mint.

types.name: MaxSupplyUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted by `set_max_supply`. EVM: `MaxSupplyUpdated`.

types.name: MintEvent
docs: Emitted on a USDC-backed mint. EVM: `OkuMMinted`.

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC deposited (6 decimals)

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM minted (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: `raw_oku_m_amount * multiplier / PRECISION`

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical multiplier from the rate schedule (not the display mirror)

types.name: MinterAllowanceUpdatedEvent
docs: Emitted by `set_minter_allowance`. EVM: `MinterAllowanceUpdated`.

types.name: MultiplierUpdated
docs: Emitted by the emergency multiplier override only (a forced jump that
halts the schedule). EVM: `OkuMMultiplierUpdated`.

fields.name: old_multiplier
docs: Canonical multiplier just before the override, WAD-scaled

fields.name: new_multiplier
docs: Multiplier forced by the override, WAD-scaled

fields.name: total_supply
docs: OkuM supply at the override (6 decimals)

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix time of the override

types.name: PauseEvent
docs: Emitted by `pause`. EVM: OZ `Paused`.

types.name: PendingRateCancelled
docs: Emitted when an armed successor is discarded or replaced before activating.
No EVM event of this name (EVM emits `UIMultiplierUpdateCancelled`).

fields.name: cancelled_rate
docs: The successor rate that will no longer take over, WAD-scaled

fields.name: cancelled_pending_rate_end
docs: That successor's own expiry

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Unix time of the cancelling write

types.name: PendingYieldRateUpdated
docs: Emitted when the pre-staged successor rate changes. The handover itself
emits nothing, so this is the record of it being armed.
EVM: `NextOkuMYieldRateSet`.

fields.name: rate_end
docs: Active window expiry, i.e. when the successor takes over

fields.name: pending_rate_end
docs: The successor's own expiry

types.name: PsmConfig
docs: PSM configuration PDA, seeds `["psm_config"]`: authorities, token
references, limits and the rate schedule.

fields.name: bump
docs: PDA bump, stored so signer seeds need no re-derivation

fields.name: role_admin
docs: Grants/revokes all roles

fields.name: pauser
docs: Pause only

fields.name: unpauser
docs: Unpause only

fields.name: freezer
docs: Freeze accounts

fields.name: unfreezer
docs: Thaw accounts

fields.name: buffer_depositor
docs: Deposit USDC buffer

fields.name: buffer_withdrawer
docs: Withdraw USDC buffer

fields.name: cap_manager
docs: Set max supply

fields.name: allowance_manager
docs: Reset minter / direct-minter / direct-burner allowances

fields.name: rate_manager
docs: Sets the rate schedule and emergency multiplier override (display
sync is permissionless)

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: USDC mint (standard SPL Token, `USDC_DECIMALS` decimals)

fields.name: oku_m_mint
docs: Token-2022 mint with `ScaledUiAmount`; that extension is a write-only
display mirror, never read for pricing

fields.name: vault_usdc
docs: PSM's USDC buffer vault (ATA)

fields.name: max_supply
docs: Supply cap in raw OkuM units (6 decimals)

fields.name: minter_allowance
docs: Remaining mint allowance (6 decimals), reset by `allowance_manager`

fields.name: is_paused
docs: Set by `pause`, cleared by `unpause`; blocks every value-moving path

fields.name: last_override_slot
docs: Slot of the last emergency override (`set_okum_multiplier`); user
operations are blocked in that slot.

fields.name: okum_base_multiplier
docs: Multiplier snapshot at `okum_last_accrual_time`, WAD-scaled. Starts at
`PRECISION`; re-snapshotted on every schedule write.

fields.name: okum_rate_per_second
docs: Active per-second rate, WAD-scaled. `PRECISION` means no yield.

fields.name: okum_last_accrual_time
docs: Timestamp `okum_base_multiplier` was snapshotted at.

fields.name: okum_rate_end
docs: Expiry of `okum_rate_per_second`. `0` only when halted; every yielding
rate has a bounded window so an unattended schedule halts.

fields.name: okum_pending_rate_per_second
docs: Pre-staged successor rate, active from `okum_rate_end` with no
transaction. `PRECISION` means none armed.

fields.name: okum_pending_rate_end
docs: Successor's own expiry. `0` = none armed.

fields.name: last_display_sync_ts
docs: Unix time of the last `sync_display_multiplier`. Observability only.

fields.name: pending_role_admin
docs: Pending `role_admin` target of the two-step rotation (set by
`set_authority(RoleAdmin, ..)`, committed by `accept_role_admin`).
`Pubkey::default()` = no pending rotation.

fields.name: direct_minter
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = disabled

fields.name: direct_minter_allowance
docs: Direct-mint allowance (6 decimals), separate from `minter_allowance`

fields.name: direct_burner
docs: `Pubkey::default()` = disabled

fields.name: direct_burner_allowance
docs: Direct-burn allowance (6 decimals)

fields.name: reserved
docs: Reserved tail for future fields; consume from the front and shrink the
array so `LEN` stays constant (there is no `realloc` instruction).

types.name: RedeemEvent
docs: Emitted on redemption. EVM: `OkuMRedeemed`.

fields.name: raw_oku_m_amount
docs: OkuM burned (6 decimals)

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: USDC paid out (6 decimals)

fields.name: dollar_value
docs: Dollar value of the OkuM burned; always equal to `usdc_amount`

fields.name: multiplier
docs: Canonical multiplier from the rate schedule (not the display mirror)

fields.name: new_total_supply
docs: OkuM supply after the burn (6 decimals)

types.name: RoleAdminTransferAcceptedEvent
docs: Emitted by `accept_role_admin`.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferCancelledEvent
docs: Emitted by `cancel_role_admin_transfer`.

types.name: RoleAdminTransferProposedEvent
docs: Emitted when `set_authority(RoleAdmin, ..)` proposes a transfer; it takes
effect only when the new admin calls `accept_role_admin`.

types.name: ThawEvent
docs: Emitted by `thaw_account`. EVM: `Unblacklisted`.

types.name: UnpauseEvent
docs: Emitted by `unpause`. EVM: OZ `Unpaused`.

types.name: YieldRateUpdated
docs: Emitted when the active rate or its window changes. EVM: `OkuMYieldRateUpdated`.

fields.name: old_rate
docs: Previous per-second rate, WAD-scaled

fields.name: new_rate
docs: New per-second rate, WAD-scaled; `PRECISION` means halted

fields.name: rate_end
docs: Absolute expiry of the new rate; `0` when halting

fields.name: base_multiplier
docs: Multiplier snapshot taken at this write, so indexers can reconstruct
`m(t)` without replaying history
